title: Tokyo Advertising Co., Ltd. – BEYOND THE RULE
text:
Tokyo Advertising Co., Ltd. – BEYOND THE RULE
Where strategy meets imagination - Tokyo Advertising crafts bold ideas and seamless media experiences that turn brands into stories people love.
What we do
Strategy
Developing a communication strategy to solve the problem.
What makes the target group like the brand and buy the product? What is the right brand experience? We uncover insights and develop ideas thoroughly in order to realise the optimum communication to solve these issues.
Creative
Creating communications that connect the target with the brand.
We build communications that capture the target's awareness and provoke action. The creative approach of our staff, who have worked on a number of fashion and sports brands, leads to unique content to solve problems and put it into practice.
Media Marketing
Strategic media planning and buying.
From magazine and web media planning to buying, we build strategies to meet the challenges of your brand. In particular, editorial tie-ups and publicity in close partnership with publishers are an effective solution for communication strategies.
